fusions.name: Carried for Miles
fusions.desc: A thrown sting that deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, up to 1.3 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 25% health; the blow deals 22 damage plus 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it, which is used up. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Double-Time
fusions.desc: Darts you 4 tiles forward, then your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Chased Off Comes Back
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once, and you move and attack 5% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
